query: select c.relname as table_name, pc.contype, pc.conname, pg_get_constraintdef(pc.oid) as definition from pg_constraint pc join pg_class c on c.oid=pc.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and pc.contype in ('c','u','f','p','x') order by 1,2,3
